references.text: Israel's journey through the Valley of Zered is also mentioned here as part of their trek through the wilderness toward the Promised Land.
Part of Israel's travel route, documenting their wanderings in the wilderness before entering Canaan.
The continuation of this text describes the time it took from Kadesh-Barnea until they crossed the Brook Zered.
Isaiah mentions the Valley of Zered (the poplar valley) in connection with Moab, the same area Israel passed through.
